title: Zoom in: moving one tenant to another shard while it stays online
caption: Copy and catch up while the tenant keeps working; the only pause is a second-long freeze of that one tenant before the map flips.

messages.label: snapshot tenant 812
messages.note: Take a consistent snapshot of the tenant's rows and remember the change-log position.

messages.label: bulk copy
messages.note: Tenant 812 keeps reading and writing on shard 2 the whole time.

messages.label: stream changes since snapshot
messages.note: Replay the change log until shard 4 is only milliseconds behind.

messages.label: tenant 812: pause writes
messages.note: Writes for this one tenant wait (about a second); every other tenant is unaffected.

messages.label: tenant 812 → shard 4 (v18)
messages.note: The single atomic step that makes the move real.

messages.label: push v18
messages.note: Routers switch; held writes resume on shard 4.

messages.label: delete tenant 812 rows
messages.note: Later, after a rollback window of a day or so.

scenarios.name: Target fails mid-copy
scenarios.summary: Because the map flips last, a failed move is simply abandoned: the source was authoritative all along.

messages.label: stream changes
messages.note: Shard 4's disk fails halfway through the catch-up.

messages.label: verify counts
messages.note: No answer: the move is marked failed.

messages.label: no change
messages.note: The map still says shard 2; the tenant never noticed.

messages.label: retry to shard 3 later
messages.note: Partial data on shard 4 is discarded.

scenarios.name: Copy can't catch up
scenarios.summary: If a tenant writes faster than changes can be replayed, the lag never reaches zero. Throttle, or move it at a quiet hour.

messages.label: stream changes (lag 40 s)
messages.note: A nightly import writes faster than shard 4 applies changes.

messages.label: stream changes (lag 55 s)
messages.note: The lag grows, so the write pause before the flip would be far too long.

messages.label: back off until 02:00
messages.note: Abort or pause, and retry when the tenant is quiet; alert if a move keeps failing.

scenarios.name: Alternative: dual writes
scenarios.summary: Writing to both shards from the app avoids a change-log pipeline, but every write path must handle one side failing.

messages.label: write
messages.note: Every write for tenant 812 goes to both shards.

messages.label: write fails
messages.note: If one side fails the two copies diverge, so a repair job must compare and fix them.
